references.text: God had previously forbidden Balaam to go with Balak's men, but now he gives permission on the condition that Balaam speak only what God commands.
The Lord's angel repeats the same command: Balaam must speak only the word that God gives him.
Balaam confirms that he must be careful to speak only what the Lord puts in his mouth.
Balaam explains that he must do everything the Lord says.
Balaam declares that he cannot go beyond the Lord's command, neither for good nor for evil.
God came to Abimelech at night in a dream, just as he now comes to Balaam at night.
God came to Laban at night in a dream and warned him, a similar pattern of divine revelation at night.
God speaks to people at night through dreams and visions to warn and guide them.
